stories.headline: Path of Exile 2 will add a death recap with damage details in its December 1.0 release
stories.summary: Game director Jonathan Rogers confirmed at ExileCon that Path of Exile 2's December 11 version 1.0 will include a death recap explaining damage taken and how much was mitigated. Damage-over-time attribution is still incomplete, and the team is working on it. Grinding Gear Games says the feature should help players identify defensive weaknesses and report improperly balanced enemies.

stories.headline: Massive Effect: The BioWare Story documentary is planned for 2027 after the studio's closure
stories.summary: Director Akash Sherman says production on the documentary about BioWare was already two years underway when EA shut the studio down. The film includes interviews with founders Ray Muzyka, Greg Zeschuk and Augustine Yip as well as longtime developers and voice actor Jennifer Hale. It is currently expected in 2027, without a confirmed release date.

stories.headline: Bit Reactor reportedly lays off more staff following Star Wars Zero Company's launch
stories.summary: PC Gamer reports that several Bit Reactor employees have said they were laid off, following earlier furloughs and the studio's decision to rehire some staff. The number of new layoffs is not confirmed. The report identifies staff in art, UI engineering and QA, despite Star Wars Zero Company reportedly reaching one million sales after launch.

stories.headline: Mass Effect: Universe composer Sam Hulick shares his re-scored trailer for N7 Day
stories.summary: Mass Effect series composer Sam Hulick released his own new soundtrack edit of the leaked Mass Effect: Universe trailer for N7 Day. Hulick said BioWare had previously approached him to score an internal demo, but that work ended when the studio was shut down. The released edit is a personal tribute, not a revival announcement for the cancelled game.

stories.headline: AMD says it is data-center-first and forecasts a PC market slump in 2027
stories.summary: In a November 5 interview, AMD CEO Lisa Su emphasized the company's expansion in AI data centers, describing AMD as a data-center-first company. Separately, during its third-quarter earnings call, Su forecast a double-digit decline in overall PC sales during 2027. Neither statement announces a new GPU price or a specific consumer hardware change.

stories.headline: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor returns to PC with widescreen and bug fixes
stories.summary: SNEG re-released the 2001 Dungeons & Dragons dungeon crawler on Steam and GOG on November 6. The updated edition fixes numerous original bugs and adds widescreen and 4K support, full controller support, sharper visuals, an improved interface, adjustable combat speed and an optional Legacy mode. A free Steam demo is also available.

game.name: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor

stories.headline: WARDOGS Season 3 adds an urban map, limited mode and major anti-cheat crackdown
stories.summary: BULKHEAD says WARDOGS Season 3 launches November 12 with the new urban Sabatulo map, a Limited mode restricting high-end gear, and more flexible role-based unlocks. The studio says its machine-learning-assisted anti-cheat system analysed 187 million hours of gameplay and banned about 185,000 accounts. Full Season 3 patch notes are still pending.

stories.headline: Skyrim mod Aurbis brings persistent MMO-style multiplayer to Tamriel
stories.summary: The Aurbis community project turns Skyrim into a persistent shared roleplaying world, with player-created groups, an economy, crafting, cooperative dungeons, PvP, survival mechanics and more demanding character progression. The project is in invite-only early access rather than a full public release. It requires a legitimate Skyrim installation on version 1.6.1170, with a custom launcher managing the mod setup.

game.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
